text:
samir: Heads-up — scheduling Lyric Systems private rollout for Thu 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. This is a Dedicated -> Private slice handoff. Need quick approvals: KMS window OK, runtime/model pin, smoke test checklist, and rollback thresholds.

deploybot: deploy job created • id=rb-deploy-9876 • scheduled=2026-03-25T02:00:00Z • target=lyric-systems-prod-private
`deploybot: /deploy schedule --id rb-deploy-9876 --slice lyric-systems --env private --when 2026-03-25T02:00Z`

lucas: +1 to schedule but please pin runtime to v1.12.3 and model to redwood-4-quant. We saw a perf divergence on v1.13 in last run.

maya: Can you drop release notes? Need list of user-visible changes and cust-specific config (kms key id, VPC CIDRs). Also we need to confirm maintenance window (2h?)

samir: window is 2h (02:00-04:00 UTC). Release notes draft: https://internal.docs/rls/lyric-2026-03-25 (WIP)

ops-jen: QA smoke test plan: 1) health-check probe x10, 2) 100 short inference calls (golden prompts), 3) KV cache warm-up. Tagging required tests in runbook: `sops/rollouts/lyric/smoke-tests.md`. Need one SRE and one SE to ack before traffic shift.

tariq: Canary: start at 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m if metrics good. Rollback triggers: error rate >3% sustained for 5m OR median p95 latency increase >50% vs baseline for 5m. Also alert if GPU memory spike >90% on any instance.

lucas: Agree with canary. Also pin env var `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FLAGS=--kv-cache-size=4G` for this tenant to avoid cold-start regressions.

samir: Added rollback script to release bucket: `s3://redwood-releases/rollback/lyric/rb-9876.sh`. Ops-jen please verify perms for runbook.

ops-jen: Verified perms. I ran the smoke checklist locally (dry-run). Leaving comments in the runbook. Need Maya to confirm release notes link before I give final ack.

maya: Release notes updated with KMS key id (kms-lyric-02) and tenant config. Added note about model quantization change under 'Risks'. Link: https://internal.docs/rls/lyric-2026-03-25#notes

deploybot: update: job rb-deploy-9876 now pinned runtime=v1.12.3, model=redwood-4-quant, flags=`--kv-cache-size=4G`. Canary policy set: 5%->25%->100% with staged durations.

samir: @lucas @ops-jen @maya this looks good. Final approve? :thumbsup:

lucas: :thumbsup: pinned and approved.

ops-jen: :white_check_mark: smoke tests pass in staging, perms good, runbook attached.

maya: :thumbsup: release notes + customer notif prepared.

samir: Approved — proceeding to scheduled window. I will be on the war-room channel during rollout. If anything goes sideways, call rollback using `s3://redwood-releases/rollback/lyric/rb-9876.sh` and escalate to oncall.

deploybot: deploy triggered at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z • monitoring hooks enabled • notify-on-fail=ops-oncall@redwood.internal

samir: Thanks team.
